content.title: Chapter 22 - BUSINESSES — Sec. 22-161. - Purpose.
content.summary:
This chapter is enacted for the purpose of promoting the health, safety, and welfare
               of the citizens by regulating and licensing massage parlors.
(Code 1981, § 16-1; Ord. No. 3292, § 1, 10-21-1996)
